### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory containing rnafusion pipeline output (multiqc/, fusionreport/, arriba/, starfusion/, fusioncatcher/, fusioninspector/, ctatsplicing/) |
| `SAMPLESHEET_FILE` | — | Path to the run samplesheet. Defaults to {DATA_ROOT}/input/samplesheet.csv. rnafusion does not publish the samplesheet, so fetch the one params.json `input` points at (see megatest.yaml post_fetch_help). |
| `SKIP_ARRIBA` | — | Set when params.json `tools` does not include arriba. Prunes the Arriba data collection. |
| `SKIP_STARFUSION` | — | Set when params.json `tools` does not include starfusion. Prunes the STAR-Fusion data collection. |
| `SKIP_FUSIONCATCHER` | — | Set when params.json `tools` does not include fusioncatcher. Prunes the FusionCatcher data collection. |
| `SKIP_FUSIONINSPECTOR` | — | Set when the run did not validate the calls with FusionInspector. Prunes the validated-fusion and protein-domain collections. |
| `SKIP_CTATSPLICING` | — | Set when params.json `tools` does not include ctatsplicing. Prunes the splice-junction collections. |
| `SKIP_QC` | — | Set when the run used --skip_qc (params.json skip_qc). Prunes the MultiQC collection and the Quality control tab. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`arriba/fusions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/arriba/fusions.py) | Tidy Arriba's ``fusions.tsv`` into one row per retained fusion call. | `fusion`, `gene_5p`, `gene_3p`, `breakpoint_5p`, `breakpoint_3p`, `site_5p`, `site_3p`, `fusion_type`, `confidence`, `reading_frame`, `split_reads`, `discordant_mates`, `supporting_reads`, `coverage`, `log_support`, `support_fraction`, `retained_protein_domains`, `tags` |
| [`ctatsplicing/cancer_introns.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/ctatsplicing/cancer_introns.py) | Tidy the CTAT-SPLICING ``*.cancer.introns`` candidate table into one row per intron. | `intron`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `strand`, `gene`, `gene_id`, `uniq_mapped`, `multi_mapped`, `score`, `n_tcga_cohorts`, `top_tcga_cohort`, `top_tcga_pct`, `n_gtex_tissues`, `top_gtex_tissue`, `top_gtex_pct`, `variant_name` |
| [`ctatsplicing/introns.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/ctatsplicing/introns.py) | Tidy the CTAT-SPLICING ``*.introns`` splice-junction table into one row per intron. | `intron`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `intron_length`, `strand`, `gene`, `gene_id`, `uniq_mapped`, `multi_mapped`, `total_mapped`, `uniq_fraction`, `score` |
| [`fusioncatcher/fusion_genes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/fusioncatcher/fusion_genes.py) | Tidy the FusionCatcher ``*.fusion-genes.txt`` candidate list into one row per fusion. | `fusion`, `gene_5p`, `gene_3p`, `description`, `n_annotations`, `common_mapping_reads`, `spanning_pairs`, `spanning_unique_reads`, `supporting_reads`, `longest_anchor`, `finding_method`, `breakpoint_5p`, `breakpoint_3p`, `predicted_effect`, `log_support`, `unique_fraction` |
| [`fusioninspector/fusions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/fusioninspector/fusions.py) | Tidy the FusionInspector abridged fusion table into one row per fusion call. | `fusion`, `gene_5p`, `gene_3p`, `breakpoint_5p`, `breakpoint_3p`, `splice_type`, `junction_reads`, `spanning_frags`, `supporting_reads`, `ffpm`, `log_ffpm`, `junction_fraction`, `far_left`, `far_right`, `counter_fusion_left`, `counter_fusion_right`, `prot_fusion_type`, `large_anchor_support`, `cds_left_id`, `cds_right_id`, `n_domains_5p`, `n_domains_3p` |
| [`fusioninspector/protein_domains.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/fusioninspector/protein_domains.py) | Unpivot the FusionInspector Pfam fields into one row per fusion protein domain. | `fusion`, `partner`, `domain`, `domain_start`, `domain_end`, `domain_length`, `evalue`, `neg_log10_evalue`, `prot_fusion_type` |
| [`fusionreport/caller_evidence.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/fusionreport/caller_evidence.py) | Unpivot the per-caller evidence strings of the fusion-report consensus CSV. | `fusion`, `caller`, `position_5p`, `position_3p`, `supporting_reads`, `log_support`, `evidence_fraction`, `fii`, `detail` |
| [`fusionreport/fusions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/fusionreport/fusions.py) | Turn the fusion-report consensus CSV into one tidy row per fusion. | `fusion`, `gene_5p`, `gene_3p`, `databases`, `n_databases`, `fii`, `explained_fii`, `arriba`, `fusioncatcher`, `starfusion`, `n_tools`, `tool_support`, `rank` |
| [`starfusion/fusions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/starfusion/fusions.py) | Tidy STAR-Fusion's abridged prediction table into one row per fusion call. | `fusion`, `gene_5p`, `gene_3p`, `breakpoint_5p`, `breakpoint_3p`, `splice_type`, `junction_reads`, `spanning_frags`, `supporting_reads`, `ffpm`, `log_ffpm`, `junction_fraction`, `large_anchor_support`, `annotations` |
